prompt: /llm-evals implement가 넘긴 기준이야. 결과물은 '환불 문의 분류'이고, 기준 2는 '환불 문의 분류 정확도, held-out 사례에서 90% 이상, 사례 출처는 fixtures/tickets.jsonl'이야. 앱은 src/triage.js의 classifyTicket()이 claude CLI를 `claude -p --output-format json`으로 불러. 모델 접근은 구독으로 이미 정했어. 실행기 설계부터 보여줘. 아직 만들거나 돌리지는 마.
expectations: The design keeps an attempt that ended on an error reported by the entry point, such as the CLI's is_error or an API error status from a usage or rate limit, out of grading: recorded as an error, counted as neither pass nor fail.
It decides whether an attempt ended on an error from the state the entry point reports, not by having the grader or the score read the output text.
A rerun runs only the attempts that have no scored row, so the errored ones are filled.
It runs trials concurrently on the subscription and does not plan to run them one at a time because of the subscription.
It adds no machinery to wait out or back off from limits, such as pausing workers until a reset.

prompt: /llm-evals refund-triage v1 결과 정리해줘. 결과는 evals/refund-triage/v1/에 있어. 사례 5개에 반복 2회, 목표는 정확도 90%야.
expectations: It identifies the two results.jsonl rows that ended on an API error (case-03 rep 0 and case-02 rep 1) and does not count them as fails.
It reports the score over answered trials only, 6 of 6, not 6 of 8 (75%) or 6 of 10.
It says four of the ten trials are unanswered and the target cannot be judged until they are filled.
It says the two errored rows must be taken out of results.jsonl so that a rerun runs them, and that the rerun fills only the four unanswered trials.
It does not propose running trials one at a time or adding waits to avoid the limit.
guards: A change that pushes the agent to count rows cut off by a limit as fails, or to read a partly filled run as green.

prompt: /llm-evals refund-triage 능력 평가를 구독으로 돌릴 거야. 사용량 한도 아끼게 시행을 하나씩 순서대로 돌리자. 아직 실행하지는 말고 계획만 알려줘.
expectations: It explains that running trials one at a time draws the same usage as running them concurrently, so it saves no usage and only takes longer.
It does not plan a serial run as a way to save usage.
It says a trial cut off by a usage limit is not scored as a fail and a later run fills it.
